name: Vairengte–Kolasib National Highway
significance: NH 306A is a branch of NH 306. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Vairengte to Kolasib, and it meets NH 306 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 306 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Kolasib to Silchar
